user.title: Panasonic Eolia AC Authentication
user.description:
1. Open the following link to log in with your CLUB Panasonic / Eolia account:

[**👉 Click here to authenticate with Panasonic**]({auth_url})

*(Or copy and paste this URL into your browser:)*
`{auth_url}`

2. After login, your browser will redirect to a `panasonic-eolia://...` page (it's normal if the page cannot be displayed).
3. Copy the full address bar URL (or authorization code / refresh token) and paste it below:

data.token_or_url: Redirected URL, Code, or Refresh Token
